m: The {Juggler} bounces on the {Rooftop} above the {Boxing Ring}, juggling sprigs of purple **chaste tree** blossom. He loses his balance and lands in the town *stocks*, wedged among tall *grass*. The boxers below wave branches of **chaste tree** at him like fans, and bees buzz round his trapped head.

The {Tsar} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room}, which sits on a *lofty peak* above the clouds. He plants a flag that reads **Cui**, the family name of everyone who lives up here. Snow falls, the flag freezes, and goats from the whole mountain come to bleat "**Cui**!" at the top of their voices.

The {Yogi} sits by the {Trapdoor} at the edge of the {Mansion}'s *cliff* when a *wild goose* waddles out of it, honking. Behind it come a hundred more, in a perfect V. The yogi joins the end of the line, flapping his arms, and the leading **wild goose** carries him south with the other **wild goose** travellers.

The {Sheriff} rides the Ferris wheel up to the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}, where the **gentry** are having a picnic in top hats. Their sashes are made of *silk thread* and pinned with a golden *skewer*. They serve him a single grape on a silver tray, and he decides he would make fine **gentry** himself.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion}, which has sunk to the bottom of the sea. The sea *king* swims up holding a *bamboo book* whose pages have turned to pink **coral**. Fish nibble the words, and the sheriff arrests a crab for stealing a chapter of **coral**.

The {Baker} rushes into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} where a *list of names* hangs on a *tree* growing beside the *roadside* door. He scans the **list of names** for the winners of the cake contest. His name is last, so he bakes a giant cake, nails it to the tree and adds himself to the top of the **list of names**.

The {Sailor} pops out of a {Trapdoor} on the {Lagoon} jetty and stands at the mouth of a *tunnel*. He **recites** a sea poem, and each line floats out as a *small speech bubble* that echoes down the tunnel. The fish learn every word and **recite** it back to him, bubbling.

The {Baker} hides by the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar}, standing very **near** a *standing person* who is selling buns at the *roadside*. He creeps closer and closer, until he is so **near** that their noses touch. Then he whispers: "Your buns are too small," and drops through the trapdoor.

The {Yogi} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} to greet a *gentleman* who can paint, sing, fence and bake, all at once. He is so **accomplished** that he juggles the yogi's teapots while reciting a sonnet. The yogi tries to look **accomplished** too and stands on his head, then falls over.

The {Chef} wobbles down the {Staircase} of the {Casino} hugging a *wine jug* for the *feast*. A drop of strong **alcohol** splashes on the roulette wheel, and it spins faster and faster. The gamblers sniff the air, giggle, and the whole casino sways, dizzy with **alcohol** fumes.

The {Dentist} sits on the wooden {Staircase} down to the {Beach}, carving a stick of *bamboo* into a **flute**. She blows a note, and a *sprouting field* of seaweed pops up from the sand to dance. She plays faster, and crabs line up to have their claws drilled into tiny **flutes** too.

The {Cheerleader} bounces up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} with her pompoms, and a flock of *fowl* follows her, flapping and clucking. Hens, ducks and one confused goose form a pyramid on the landing. The guests cheer the dancing **fowl**, and the innkeeper serves breakfast to every **fowl** in the building.

The {Wizard} stands over the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool}, waving a red *pennant* that says **do not**. **Do not** dive, it says; do not splash, do not open the trapdoor. Then he trips, the trapdoor bursts open, and a whale leaps out.

The {Juggler} tiptoes across the {Rooftop} of the {Mint}, where a *woman* dances among glittering coins. She spins on one toe, light as a *silkworm*'s thread, so **graceful** that the coins pause mid-air to watch. The juggler tries to copy her and falls into a bucket, the least **graceful** moment in history.

The {Magician} crouches on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café}, closing one *eye* to **take aim** at a mouse hiding in a pot of *young crop*. He flicks his wand, but the cats leap first. All twenty of them **take aim** at the mouse, and the mouse takes aim at the cheese.

The {Jockey} rides through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swamp} and counts the houses on stilts: one **building counter**, two, three. Each **building counter** is marked by a *towel* hung from its roof. A *schoolkid* paddles past, laughing, and swaps the towels around so he has to count all over again.

The {King} rows into the {Boathouse} and finds bandits dropping through the {Trapdoor} to **plunder** his treasure. They tear off the *roof*, grab golden oars and crowns and **plunder** even his rubber duck. The king splashes after them shouting, but they sail away laughing.

The {Dentist} hides in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, pressing one *eye* to a peephole to **observe** a *busy man* who is polishing every tile with a toothbrush. She takes notes, then **observes** him brushing a duck's teeth too. She hires him on the spot.

The {Hunter} sits in the {Waiting Room} as a sly man pops up from the {Trapdoor} *holding meat* in one hand and a pearly *shell* in the other. He slides them to the receptionist: pure **bribery**, to jump the queue. She takes the meat but throws the shell, and everyone boos the **bribery**.

The {Tsar} stomps into the {Basement} of a hut on the {Island}, where a *fruit picker* has left mangoes all over the floor. The tsar's *kicking foot* comes down and **steps on** one: splat! Juice flies. He slips, slides and **steps on** every mango in the room.

The {Tailor} sews on the {Staircase} beside the {Boxing Ring} as *rain* pours into the open *courtyard*. Suddenly a **clap of thunder** booms so loud her needle flies into the ring and knocks out the champion. The crowd roars like a second **clap of thunder**.

The {Wizard} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, where a soggy *crow* opens its *mouth* and lets out a sad **whimper**. Its feathers are wet. The wizard dries it with a hot spell, but singes its tail, and the crow gives an even longer **whimper**.

The {Gardener} kneels in the {Basement} of a hut by the {Lagoon} and puts his *joined hands* together to **cup hands** under a dripping pipe. A *helping hand* from his neighbour **cups hands** below his, and soon they have a tower of cupped hands holding a goldfish.

The {Firefighter} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of a palace on the {Lake} to rescue the **imperial consort**. The *woman* has tied her silk sashes into a *coiled rope* and swings down past the firefighter. She saves herself, the emperor and a cat, the most daring **imperial consort** ever.

The {Magician} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} to perform his best trick. The yeti yawns, picks a blade of *grass* from its teeth and says, "Is that all?" It loves to **belittle** everything. The magician turns it into a snowman, which goes on to **belittle** the snow.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} in a *dugout canoe*. A *small speech bubble* floats out of the emperor's statue: a royal **decree**. "Everyone must paddle!" So the visitors climb into canoes and row across the marble floor, obeying the **decree**.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands on a royal *proclamation* floating in the water. A spider swims up and **binds** her ankles with *silk thread*. She wriggles free and uses the thread to **bind** the spider to a lilo.

The {Gardener} sneaks down to the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *teetering man* is whispering a *small speech bubble* into the ear of a potted plant. He is a **sly** fox in a suit. He swaps all the waiting tickets so he goes first. The plant winks: just as **sly**.

The {Pirate} climbs a vine {Staircase} in the {Jungle} and has a *chance meeting* with a panda weaving *bamboo* into a giant **sail**. Together they lash it to a hollow log, and the wind fills the **sail**. Off they rush through the trees, steering past monkeys.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} when a *sudden flash* of lightning splits the sky. *Water drops* pour down until the lawn, the gardens and the ground floor **flood**. The rising water lifts him, still cross-legged, and he floats on as the whole valley **floods**.

The {Wizard} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} clutching a *rice bowl* in the light of the *moon*. He lands and twists his **wrist**. He waves his wand to heal it, but his **wrist** now spins like a propeller and stirs the rice into soup.

The {Jockey} lights *embers* in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and sets a giant pot on top. A *busy man* tosses in noodles, eggs and a rubber duck to **boil**. The water bubbles so hard that the whole swimming pool starts to **boil** too, and the swimmers come out as dumplings.

The {Cheerleader} slides down through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and lands beside a *standing person* in a dress made of *moss*. She is so **pretty** that the bank clerks forget to count. The cheerleader paints herself green to look **pretty** too, and a frog proposes to her.

The {Zookeeper} climbs the {Staircase} out of the {Pool} and finds a *pawn* from a giant chessboard in a tiny helmet. It salutes: a brave **soldier**. It marches into the deep end, gurgles, and twenty more **soldier** pawns follow it in.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} with a telescope to **survey** his land. His *strong arm* holds an *overflowing bowl* of soup in the other hand. He **surveys** the hills, the river, then spills soup on the gardener, who surveys him back angrily.

The {Shepherd} lights *incense* on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} and taps a *chime stone*: ding! The smoke spreads, so **fragrant** that the guests float up in their pyjamas, sniffing. The sheep in the yard below start to smell **fragrant** too, like roses, and bees follow them home in a buzzing cloud.

The {Dentist} drops a *bean* down the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} to **tease** a hungry duck. It quacks, she pulls the bean away on a string, it waddles after it down the *road*. She **teases** it all the way to the bakery, then gives it a whole loaf.

The {Dentist} pops out of a {Trapdoor} in the {Yen Exchange} and finds herself far out in the **outskirts** of town, among *rice field* after rice field. Farmers wrapped in a *blanket* swap pennies for rice. Even the money changers moved to the **outskirts**, where the rent is lower.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a *bargain bin* full of gold watches. Everything is so **cheap** that he buys a crown for one coin and a castle for two. Then the bin sells him for a penny, and he finds out he is **cheap** too.

The {Chef} lights a *campfire* in the {Basement} of the {Tower} and tosses noodles in a wok to **stir-fry** them. He adds a *pinch* of chilli, and the noodles leap out and **stir-fry** themselves, swirling round the room like a tornado of dinner.

The {Tsar} pops up through a {Trapdoor} in the {Mansion} lawn and lights a *campfire* on a *mountain* of firewood. It blazes so high the night turns gold: **glorious**! He sings, the fireworks join in, and the sunrise arrives early just to see the **glorious** blaze.

The {Chef} goes down into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} with a *cane* and knocks out every wall, then climbs into the *attic* and knocks out the ceiling. Now the basement is so **spacious** he can cook for an army. Planes taxi in for lunch, it is that **spacious**.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa}, where a *bug* coats a slab of *sun-dried meat* in yellow **wax**. The steam melts it, and the guests get slathered in hot **wax** instead. They come out shiny, smooth and smelling of honey.

The {Cheerleader} bounces down the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} and finds a *person* locked inside a *fence* in the hallway: a **prisoner** of the laundry rules. She cheers him up with a dance and passes him a spoon. He digs out, and now she is the **prisoner**.

The {Lifeguard} opens a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and finds a *cabinet* hidden under a *tree*. It's crammed with spiky **chestnuts**. A squirrel pops out and pelts her with them. She roasts a **chestnut** on the sand and offers it back as a peace gift.

The {Gardener} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} and finds an *antique* vase stuffed with *chili* peppers. Someone has committed a **crime**: the vase was stolen from the museum. A detective arrives, sniffs, sneezes, and arrests the chili for the **crime**.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange}, landing on a giant **cushion** of soft *soil*. A guard snaps *handcuffs* on her for breaking in, but she is so comfy she refuses to get up. The guard sits down on the **cushion** too and falls asleep.

The {Dentist} peeks up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and sees a *woman* behind a glass *door* in a golden swimsuit. The dentist turns green with **envy**. She steals the suit, but now the lifeguard **envies** her, then the ducks, then the trapdoor.

The {King} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Waiting Room}, where a crowd of ghosts argue about who is boss. The biggest *ghost* grabs the *dipper* of soup and serves himself first: he is the **chief**. The king tries to take it, but the ghosts vote and the soup ladle stays with the **chief**.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} when a *small speech bubble* floats up the steps whispering a **rumor**: "The tower is made of cheese." Every floor passes it on, the **rumor** gets bigger, and by the top a mouse is nibbling the walls.

The {Magician} sits alone by the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} under a leaky *roof*, watching the *sunset*. Nobody came to his magic show. He pulls a rabbit from his hat for company, but it hops away too, and he feels even more **lonesome**. The fort's cannon sighs, just as **lonesome**, and puffs a little smoke ring for him.

The {Sheriff} wades into the {Basement} of the {Pool} with a *fishing net* and scoops up a *curled worm* wearing a tiny map of **Sichuan**. The worm uncurls and points to the mountains of **Sichuan**, then breathes out chilli fire. The sheriff's moustache sizzles and the pool water starts to taste of hot pot.

The {Sheriff} swings a *bucket* round his head in the {Basement} of the {Wine Cellar} and **flings** it across the room. It lands on a *ski* that zooms off down the barrels. Excited, he starts to **fling** everything: bottles, corks, his hat, and finally himself onto the ski.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} to a *cliff edge* where *water drops* spray up from the sea far below. He stares out to the **horizon**, where the sky meets the water. He stretches his arms so far that his fingertips touch the **horizon**, and the sun sits in his palm like a peach.

The {Jockey} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Funfair} and finds a *tree* stump carved into a *pillow*. He lays his head on it, but it is hard as rock. So he stuffs it with candyfloss, and now the **pillow** is pink and sticky. The ghost-train skeletons queue up to borrow the **pillow** for a nap.

The {Gardener} rows to the {Island} and opens a {Trapdoor} in the sand, where a *begging bowl* sits on the bottom step. A **beggar** pops up and holds it out to her. She drops in a seed, it sprouts into a coconut tree, and the **beggar** becomes the richest man on the island.

The {Yogi} jumps into the {Basement} of a hut by the {Lagoon}, where a *stream* runs straight across the floor. He kicks *water drops* everywhere and starts to **swim**, cross-legged, in circles. Fish join him, then a crab, then the furniture, until even the armchair can **swim**.

The {King} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *big man* stands with his legs wide apart, blocking the way. The king ducks to crawl through the gap at his **crotch**, holding a *jade tablet* over his head like a shield. The big man giggles, his **crotch** is ticklish, and he topples down the stairs.

The {Magician} opens a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach}, and inside a giant *pinned heart* is slowly oozing *water drops*. It **secretes** them like sweat on a hot day. The magician catches the drops in a bottle, and they turn to perfume. Now the crabs **secrete** perfume too.

The {Yogi} paddles a *dugout canoe* up the {Staircase} of the {Museum}, along a *road* painted on the floor. The sign says "Speed limit: slow", but he **exceeds** it, whooshing past dinosaurs. The guards chase him, and they **exceed** the limit too.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} when a mosquito with a *mouth* sharp as a *nail* buzzes in. It **stings** her right on the nose. She swats, misses, and it **stings** the champion below, who punches the referee by mistake.

The {Dentist} hides beneath the {Trapdoor} of a hut on the {Island} while her *stand-in* goes out on stage. Before the show, she mixes *soot* with oil into **eyebrow paint** and draws two thick black arches on the stand-in's face. The crowd gasps, and every parrot wants **eyebrow paint** too.

The {Zookeeper} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower}, and a hot wind from the *campfire* below blasts out. The air is so **dry** that the morning *birdsong* cracks into croaks. The parrots' feathers crackle, the lizards cough, and the zookeeper's sandwiches turn **dry** as toast.

The {Jockey} pops up from the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and **throws** a *pitcher* of honey at the angry bees. A *helping hand* grabs a second pitcher and **throws** it too. The bees catch the honey mid-air, lick it, and decide they love the jockey after all.

The {Juggler} skips down the {Staircase} to the {Beach}, where *grass* grows in a *ploughed field* by the sea. He tries not to **tread on** the seedlings, but with every hop he juggles and loses track. He **treads on** a tomato, a melon and finally a sleeping crab.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, where a *tree* holds up a giant gate. He checks the *district map*, then oils the squeaky **hinge**. The gate swings so fast the whole roof spins like a door on its **hinge**.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of a hut in the {Jungle} beside a bamboo *steamer*. His *standing heart* burns: he **detests** dumplings, and the monkeys keep stealing his bananas to fill them. He **detests** the monkeys too, until they offer him one, and then it is delicious.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} above the {Boxing Ring} when a **whale** crashes up through the floor. It's a *fish* so big it carries a *palace* on its back. The boxers bounce on the **whale** like a trampoline, and it sprays water from its blowhole to cheer them on.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} beside the {Lagoon} with a *bow* taller than a house. He draws it back past his *elbow*, and the arrow flies so far it circles the world: a **great** shot. The fish jump to applaud, and the arrow returns to hit the same tree, a **great** bullseye.

The {Yogi} relaxes in the {Basement} of a {Beach} hut and starts to **lean on** a *standing person* who's an *oddball*: he never moves. When the yogi falls asleep, the oddball **leans on** him too, and they hold each other up like two playing cards.

The {Wizard} splashes in the {Basement} of the {Pool} when a *standing person* comes down to **insult** him: "Your beard looks like seaweed!" The *busy mother* who runs the pool hears this, marches over and **insults** the insulter's goggles, and everyone goes quiet.

The {Firefighter} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} and sees the garden ringed by a **hedge** made of *grass* and twigs. A goat knocks over a *slop bucket*, and the **hedge** eats the slops, growing fat. Soon the hedge is taller than the mansion, and the firefighter sprays it back.

The {Firefighter} sweeps the {Staircase} of the {Pool} when a *dollar sign* floats up and sticks to her sleeve. A *helping hand* flicks out to **brush off** the money. More dollars stick, she **brushes off** each one, and the pool fills with swimmers diving for the cash.

The {Hunter} pokes his head through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and finds a tall white *crane* standing on one leg. A smaller *bird* tries to copy it and falls over. The hunter tries too, and soon he, the bird and the **crane** stand in a wobbly row until the **crane** lifts off and leaves them.

The {Sheriff} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} with a *side dish* of honey cakes. A greedy *bug* starts to **eat into** them, crumb by crumb. Then it starts to **eat into** the staircase, the hive and the sheriff's boots.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} stirring flour into a barrel of *water*. It turns into a gloopy **thick liquid** that he tosses at the crowd. Everyone gets sticky, and the football players slide around the pitch on the **thick liquid**, scoring by accident.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Staircase} into the {Pool} where *grass* grows round a pink **lotus**. A *husband* in swim trunks sits on the lotus, refusing to come out. She sprays him with her hose, and he bobs away on the **lotus** like a little boat.

The {Lifeguard} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and finds a mountain of **garbage**: banana skins, old towels, *soil* from potted plants. A *podium* sits on top. She stands on it and delivers a speech about recycling, and the **garbage** cheers and sorts itself.

The {King} lights a *campfire* in the {Basement} of the {Tower} to **roast** marshmallows while studying for an *exam*. He gets distracted reading, and the marshmallows **roast** black. He eats them anyway and fails, but the examiner gives him extra points for crispy marshmallows.

The {Sheriff} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} to **bask** in the hot *sun*. He lies so still that a bird builds a *bird nest* on his chest. The chicks hatch, and they **bask** too, lined up like little sunbathers.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of a hut in the {Swamp} after a night of freezing *rain*. Everything sparkles white with **frost**. From his *lookout* he sees frogs skating on the frozen water, and the alligators have **frost** on their eyelashes.

The {Juggler} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} with a *standing knife* to **wipe out** a *nest* of mice. But the mice are juggling too, better than him. Instead of fighting he joins them, and together they **wipe out** every cheese in the kitchen.

The {Yogi} opens a {Trapdoor} in the {Dunes} and starts to **store up** for winter: bales of dry *grass*, blankets of *cotton padding*, jars of honey. He **stores up** so much that the trapdoor won't shut, and the camels move in for the season.

The {Juggler} lands on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} café piled with **rubbish**, where a *chaser* sprints across the *soil* after plastic bags. The juggler grabs the **rubbish** and juggles it into the bin, and the seagulls clap their wings.

The {Chef} skips down the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} wrapped in shining **silk**. A spider weaves *silk thread* round and round in a *circuit*, making more and more cloth. Soon the boats are wrapped in **silk** too and slip into the water like smooth fish.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Museum} when the floor splits and a tiny *mountain* pops up, wrapped like a *gift*. Water fills the room, and the mountain becomes an **islet**. A crab moves in, a palm tree sprouts, and the curators argue over who owns the **islet**.

The {Cheerleader} pumps *steam* into a balloon on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring}. It's **hydrogen**, the lightest gas, and the balloon rises, taking her with it. She cheers in a squeaky voice, filled with **hydrogen**, as the boxers watch her float away.

The {Tailor} leads a *horse* up the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} and notices it now has a hump. A *serpent* has curled up under its blanket! The tailor sews a saddle round the hump, and it becomes a **camel**. The **camel** spits at the serpent, which slithers off.

The {Jockey} sits on the {Rooftop} of a hut in the {Swamp} beside a *woman* perched on a *split log*. She paints her face with mud and petals: swamp **makeup**. The frogs line up for **makeup** too and hop away with pink cheeks.

The {King} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Casino} and finds a *trapped tree* tied with rope. A *helping hand* passes him a **bundle** of banknotes. He ties them to the branches, and soon the tree is a **bundle** of money, blooming with cash.

The {Cheerleader} jumps on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange}, waving *gold coins* that are really grey **lead** painted yellow. They are so heavy that the roof cracks. She falls through into the vault, and the bankers find the **lead** coins sinking in their coffee.

The {Gardener} pops out of the {Trapdoor} in the {Swamp} and starts to **stroll** along a muddy *road*. A *mad dog* barks and races after him, so he breaks into a sprint, then remembers to **stroll** and walks backwards, slowly, while the dog laughs.

The {Sheriff} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} beside his *uncle*, who is so **gentle** he catches *water drops* in a teacup so they won't hit the swimmers. He pats a wasp on the head and sings to the ducks: the most **gentle** man in town.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} where a *tree* grows a single **pomegranate**. She keeps it as a *keepsake*, but it bursts open and red seeds rain on every bed. The backpackers eat them, and the **pomegranate** tree grows another.

The {Baker} hides in the {Basement} beneath the {Boxing Ring} and props up a cake on a *tripod*. The cake comes **third** in the contest: not first, not second, but **third**. He sulks, then eats it, and the tripod wobbles away in protest.

The {Yogi} lies on a *sickbed* in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} when a *sheep* wanders in and rubs its wool on his feet. His toes start to **itch**. He scratches, giggles and falls off the bed, and now the whole hangar's planes **itch** too, scratching their wings.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a pot of *gold coins*. He melts them, adds a *pinch* of salt, and rolls them flat into **paper money**. He hangs the **paper money** out to dry, and pigeons fly off with banknotes in their beaks.

The {Tailor} kneels on the {Staircase} to the {Beach} fitting a *kicking foot* with a golden shoe. It belongs to a horse sent by the *sky god*, and the **hoof** glows. When it kicks, sand flies, and the tailor sews a second shoe for its other **hoof**.

The {Cheerleader} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Mint}, where a *dog* is guarding a mountain of coins. She cheers, and the **dog** wags its tail so hard coins fly everywhere. The bankers chase them, the **dog** chases the bankers.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of a hut by the {Lagoon} and bends his *torso* low like a *bow*: he **bows** to the sunrise. He bows so deep that his nose touches his toes and he tips into the water. The fish **bow** back politely.

The {Jockey} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} at *sunrise* and lays a giant *ruler* across the river to measure the light. Inch by inch the sun climbs until it is full **daytime**. He gallops off to race, but the ruler says the **daytime** has only nine inches left, so he hurries.

The {Zookeeper} fills a *bath* in the {Basement} of the {Tower} for the penguins, but green *grass* sprouts from the plughole. It's **aquatic grass**, waving like hair underwater. The penguins dive in and wear the **aquatic grass** as wigs, and the zookeeper has to comb them all one by one.

The {Jockey} rides onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} and finds a huge **spider** painted in shiny *red lacquer*, spinning a web between the chimneys. A little *bug* is stuck in it, waving. The jockey cuts it free, and the **spider** knits him a racing jersey as a thank-you.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} into a muddy cellar. His white *shirt* turns a deep chocolate **brown**, and a *question mark* pops above his head: where did the white go? He shakes himself like a dog, and now the walls, the cat and the ceiling are **brown** too.

The {Juggler} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Piazza}, drawing a face on a *page*. A pigeon lands on his head, and he pinches its beak with *tongs* by mistake. It pecks his **cheek**, which swells pink and round. The crowd laughs, and a child paints a pigeon on her own **cheek**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a vault where a *chieftain* and a *big man* argue over a heap of gold. She slams a giant tooth down between them to **settle** the fight once and for all. The gold coins **settle** into two neat piles, and everyone shakes hands.

The {Magician} stands by the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} at *sunset*, waving a bucket with his *strong arm* to **raise funds** for a new diving board. Every coin dropped in turns into a fish. Soon the pool is overflowing with fish, and he has to **raise funds** all over again to buy a net.

The {Dentist} lies on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} with one *ear* buried in a fluffy *pillow*. Patients wait below, but she snoozes and **delays** the appointments. "Five more minutes," she mumbles. The patients' teeth fall asleep too, and the whole mansion **delays** lunch until sunset.

The {Dentist} dances in the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where her *kicking foot* starts to **tread** on piles of rice. She scoops the rice up with a *rice scoop* and throws it in the air like confetti. Stamping and twirling, she **treads** the whole harvest into flour.

The {Lifeguard} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and finds a tiny shack on a bare *hillside* inside. It's **humble**: one stool, one candle, one sock. A happy old man lives there, and when she offers him a palace, he says his **humble** sock is all he needs.

The {Lifeguard} patrols the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a *standing person* is made of only a *spine*: a skeleton on display. Every night it wakes up lonely, so she becomes its **companion**, and they play chess with bones. The dinosaur skeleton gets jealous and wants a **companion** too.

The {Magician} pops out of the {Trapdoor} by the {Lake} and finds a *ghost* hiding inside a *sapling*. The ghost has such **charm** that the ducks swoon and the frogs propose. The magician tries to steal the ghost's **charm**, but only manages to make the sapling blush.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} to the top of the {Mansion}, which sits on a *mountain*. The *wind* blows, and thick grey **mountain mist** swirls round her ankles. She blows her whistle, and the **mountain mist** curls up into the shape of a fluffy lifeguard and whistles back.

The {Jockey} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, where a *standing person* waits at the *arrow landing*, holding a bow. It's his **nephew**, a tiny boy dressed as a bee. The **nephew** fires a candy arrow, and the bees chase the jockey for the sugar.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Ice Rink}, where a *tiger* on skates is bullying the penguins. It is **brutal**: it steals their fish and knocks over their snowmen. The ninja ties its skates together, and the tiger slides into a snowbank, a **brutal** ending for a bully.

The {Dentist} steps onto a {Trapdoor} in the {Warehouse}, and it gives way in a *landslide* of *soil* and boxes. She starts to **fall**, past shelves, past pipes, past a surprised mole. She keeps **falling** until she lands on a mattress delivery, safe and dusty.

The {Baker} opens a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and finds *throne steps* carved into a sandy *hillside*. He climbs the **throne steps** carrying a loaf for the sand king. The king is a crab, who bows and invites him to sit on the top of the **throne steps**.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where morning dew lies on the *grass* growing in the corners. Each drop glows so **lustrous** that it lights the room. The boxers stop fighting to polish their gloves until they shine, **lustrous** as pearls.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn}, under a tree with *grass* growing round its roots. Its leaves make a cool **shade**, and he never moves. The sun gets jealous and tries to sneak in, but the *shade* grows bigger and swallows it. Now the whole inn sits in **shade**.

The {Juggler} sits with *crossed legs* in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} when a *prowling dog* sneaks in. It is **cunning**: it pretends to be a cat, meows, and steals the cats' milk. The cats look at each other, then trick it back, and the dog runs off, beaten at its own **cunning** game.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} to a *gate* guarded by a *lumberjack*. Behind it, a **clique** of rich guests sips tea and refuses to let anyone in. She hoses the gate down, and the members of the **clique** are dripping wet, just like everyone else.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} with *crossed legs*, playing with *silk thread*. The cats **twist** the thread round chair legs, the lamp and the juggler. He **twists** his body to escape, but now he is tied like a pretzel.

The {Gardener} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a jar of thick white **ointment** for her sunburnt nose. She rubs it on, then the pigeons beg for some, then the chimney. Soon everything on the roof is coated in shining **ointment** and nothing will ever sunburn again.

The {King} wanders into the {Basement} of the {Water Park}, where a *show-off* is stacking *soil* into a huge sandcastle to impress him. The king sneezes, the castle starts to wobble and **collapses**. Then the show-off **collapses** too, sobbing, onto the soggy heap.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} holding a flower by its long green **stem**. The *grass* at his feet grows taller to see. He juggles flowers, and every **stem** grows longer until they twine round the ring ropes like vines.

The {Magician} sits in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} winding *silk thread* round a portrait of a smiling *face*. The face belongs to a friend on a **remote** island, so far that letters take a year. The magician tugs the thread, and the face winks back, smiling from far, far **remote** waters.

The {Lifeguard} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Spa} and blows a *trumpet* with her *mouth*: "**La**!" The steam rooms echo back "**La**!", and every guest wrapped in a towel starts to sing scales. The sauna door bangs in time, the hot tub bubbles along, and soon the whole spa is one giant choir singing nothing but "la, la, la".

The {Robot} clanks up the {Staircase} beside the {Lagoon} wearing a suit of soft **velvet** woven from *silk thread*. A *soldier* tries to salute, but strokes the robot's arm instead and purrs: so smooth. The robot blushes, and the soldier orders a **velvet** uniform for the whole army.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} trying to nap, but a *helping hand* shakes an *alarm clock* by his ear. It rings and rings to **disturb** him. The cats wake up and **disturb** the customers, and soon the café is full of yowls.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle}, where she plops down on a little **stool** with *spread feet*. A monkey steals it, then a tiger, then an elephant who flattens the **stool** into a pancake. The dentist sits on the pancake.

The {Sailor} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} at a loom carved from a *tree*. A *handsome man* passes the wooden **shuttle** back and forth, weaving sails at top speed. The **shuttle** flies so fast that it shoots off the roof and lands on a passing ship.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} holding a *pole* with two *horns* on top: a **fork**. He uses it to scoop clouds into his mouth. A pigeon lands between the horns, and now the **fork** is a nest.

The {Juggler} skips across the {Rooftop} of a palace on the {Beach}, where a noble **lady** sits with her *chin* held high. She is a *woman* so elegant that the seagulls bow. She juggles sandwiches with him, then the **lady** catches him and politely puts him on the tea table.

The {Jockey} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a scroll: an **imperial edict**. A *town crier* reads it aloud, and a *small speech bubble* floats over the crowd: "Everyone must ride backwards on Tuesdays!" The horses neigh, and the **imperial edict** blows away in the wind.

The {Ninja} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} and meets a *clown* sewing *gold coins* onto his coat as **buttons**. One pops off and bounces up the stairs, ringing like a bell. The ninja catches the **button** and sews it back on, perfectly silent.

The {Gardener} trims a *tree* on the {Rooftop} by the {Swan Pond} when an *official* in black arrives with a measuring tape. He measures the gardener for a **coffin**. Shocked, the gardener jumps into the pond, and the swans use the empty **coffin** as a boat.

The {Gardener} sits in the {Basement} of a hut in the {Jungle}, his *ear* glowing red beside a *campfire*. A monkey asks who ate the bananas, and he's so **honest** that he admits it at once. The monkeys clap and give him more bananas for being **honest**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and finds two crabs who want to **form a union**. She ties their claws with *silk thread*, and the *sky god* thunders his blessing. The crabs dance, and the starfish line up to **form a union** too.

The {Shepherd} sneaks down through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave}, where the guard yeti has gone **lax**. Its *standing heart* snores, and its belt hangs in an *untied knot*. The shepherd tiptoes past with his sheep, and even the sheep get **lax** and start napping.

The {Juggler} skips down the {Staircase} to the {Beach}, where a *woman* lies sunbathing with a *fever* of anger. She is **jealous** of the juggler's three golden balls. She grabs them, juggles them better, and now he is **jealous** of her.

The {Zookeeper} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and finds a **stove** made from a ring of baked *soil* with a *campfire* inside. He cooks soup for the lions on it. The lions want the **stove** too, so they carry it off and cook a zookeeper-shaped cake.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of a palace in the {Dunes}, sharing out sand into *even shares*. Every camel gets the same pile, perfectly **even**. One camel complains, so the yogi weighs every grain, and the piles are even more **even**.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive}, where the old queen bee, the *boss*, is retiring. Her crown passes to her son, the sailor's pet bee, who will **inherit** the whole hive. The sailor helps the bee **inherit** a honey throne.

The {Gardener} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} when a **pigeon** lands on a jar with a *fitted lid*. It pecks and pecks until the lid pops off. The *bird* finds seeds inside and calls a hundred friends, and every **pigeon** in town lands on the roof.

The {Zookeeper} fills a giant *bath* in the {Basement} of the {Tower} for the elephants. One climbs in, and water floods out the windows. They splash, spray and blow bubbles: the best **bath** ever. Then the zookeeper gets in too, and now everyone needs another **bath**.

The {Zookeeper} stands on a *scaffold* on the {Staircase} of the {Tower}, tapping a **chisel** into the stone. Chips fly, and out comes a giraffe statue that sneezes. He keeps working, and the **chisel** carves a zoo full of stone animals that walk off.

The {Wizard} sits in the {Basement} of a cabin by the {Lake}, winding *silk thread* round a globe and fixing it with a *leather strap*. Each thread marks a line of **latitude**. He pulls one, and the whole world spins, sliding along its **latitude** lines.

The {Firefighter} lifts the {Trapdoor} by the {Lake}, and *water drops* fly out of a giant kettle. The water has started to **boil**, bubbling so hard that it spits a *dollar sign* of steam. She tries to cool it, but her hose water **boils** too, and the lake becomes soup.

The {Chef} skips down the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} into an **arable field**, where every *rice field* is lined with peach trees. He picks a *longevity peach*, takes a bite and becomes a farmer, ploughing the **arable field** with a ladle.

The {Robot} pops out of the {Trapdoor} at the {Funfair} and polishes its arm into a gleaming *blade edge*. The **blade edge** is so sharp that it slices candyfloss into perfect squares. The robot ends up the champion of sushi, cutting with its **blade edge**.
